violation_type.title: Planned activities designed to meet special care needs-Accommodations (26 TAC §746.2202(1))
violation_type.short_title: Planned activities designed to meet special care needs-Accommodations
violation_type.typical_finding: The director admitted to not having a plan for children with special needs and was not able to accommodate the child due to his special need.

finding_variants.text: The director admitted to not having a plan for children with special needs and was not able to accommodate the child due to his special need.
Based on the preponderance of evidence obtained it is determined that the operation did not make all reasonable efforts/ accommodations for special care.
Based upon the investigation conducted the operation does not have documentation for accommodations from a health care professional for children with known special needs.
Four children files were reviewed and did not have special care accommodations in file for review.
